## Statement and exact model

For every positive integer `N`, the construction below has `5N+2` movable coordinates, `6N+1` reciprocal pair couplings, maximum graph degree four, and coefficients drawn from a fixed finite set. One scalar parameter `H` writes any target word of `N` stationary output bits from any previously written word. It uses nine fixed field levels and at most `3N+8` commands, including reset and return to `H=0`. Its quasistatic hard-stop operation has a non-switching margin of at least two at each intended event and a margin of at least one at each final pulse level. No threshold resolution or local address input grows with `N`.

Let every movable coordinate lie in `[-1,1]` and define

\[
E(x,H)=\sum_i\frac{c_i}{2}(1-x_i^2)
 -H\sum_i g_i x_i-\sum_i b_i x_i
 -\sum_{i<j}J_{ij}x_ix_j,\qquad J_{ij}=J_{ji}.
\]

The interval endpoints are mechanical stops. Damped downhill relaxation supplies dissipation. For endpoint signs `s_i` define

\[
f_i=g_iH+b_i+\sum_jJ_{ij}s_j,
\qquad m_i=c_i+s_if_i.
\]

The endpoint is stable in coordinate `i` exactly when `m_i>0`. It switches from `-1` to `+1` when `f_i>c_i`, and conversely when `f_i<-c_i`. If an intended coordinate has `d f_i>c_i`, then along its entire crossing `d x_i` increases: the force in the direction `d` is `c_i d x_i+d f_i>0`. Consequently this endpoint model follows from the continuous reciprocal potential; directed transition rules have not been inserted separately.

This onsite potential is a concave quadratic between stops, with finite barrier height. It is not the initially considered triangular cusp. Its finite-compliance continuation is a separate companion construction, discussed below.

## Cells and couplings

Use track cells `q_1,...,q_(2N+1)`, an auxiliary `z_i` for every track cell, and output memories `m_1,...,m_N`. Here `m_i` denotes a memory coordinate, distinct from a stability margin when used as a subscripted cell name. Define `a_i=(-1)^(i+1)`.

| Family | c | g | Couplings |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| Track q_i | 10 | 1 | `J(q_i,q_(i+1))=-10`; `J(q_i,z_i)=-4a_i` |
| Auxiliary z_i | 40 | 2 | Reciprocal coupling to its track cell |
| Memory m_j | 13 | 1 | `J(m_j,q_(2j))=J(m_j,q_(2j+1))=+1` |

# Finite-compliance continuation of the broadcast memory model

Internally supported parent construction, conditional on the producer's stated
local transition contract; no fabricated material, measured bus or new practical
advantage. Root read `network.py`, `check_construction.py` and the stored local
certificate minima. Root subsequently whole-read the separate all-N protocol
PROOF.md (11845 bytes; SHA256
3d7ca1cc0cb1a397ba5555ae45cba2a51f728ab3c28553acf2b643a916f1ebf1), checked
the reset, spatial induction, pairwise-uncoupled event boxes, degree counts,
constant tolerances and full ideal flip/work counts, and found no error. This
is completed independent mathematical acceptance of that model theorem. It
does not rest on extrapolating the finite checks. Root did not independently
replay every source-work trace or acquire a component constitutive law.

Completed independent internal check: fresh_capability_question whole-read this
continuation and independently checked the wall constant, face/drift/hold/reset
bounds, ten added levels and applicability to its local event contract. No error
found at this conditional deterministic model scope. Physical acquisition,
costs and finite-temperature fidelity remain separate claims below.

## The input that this continuation actually uses

The hard-stop model has energy

    E0(x,H) = sum_i c_i(1-x_i^2)/2 - sum_i (g_i H+b_i)x_i
              - sum_(i<j) J_ij x_i x_j,       |x_i| <= 1.

J is reciprocal. At every intended event of the producer's protocol:

1. Intended cells are mutually uncoupled, share a critical field hc and switch
   in the same direction d in {-1,+1}. Their local force at the old corner is
   d h_i(hc)=c_i.
2. Every other coordinate has hard-stop stability margin >=2 at hc for the
   ENTIRE box of intended coordinates in [-1,1]. All endpoint corners have
   stability margin >=1. These are local symbolic conditions for arbitrary N;
   the finite certificate file corroborates the stated contract at N<=4.
3. c_i<=40, sum_j |J_ij|<=25, |g_i|<=2, |b_i|<=10, |H|<=64.

The model uses positive g_i>=1; control levels and critical fields are fixed
independently of N. Mobility is one in the following dimensionless ODE.

## Replace hard stops by a finite C3 potential

On all of R^m add

    Esoft = E0 + (kappa/4) sum_i [(|x_i|-1)_+]^4,
    delta=1/1024,
    kappa = [65(1+delta)+138+1]/delta^3 = 219111489536.
